content.content:
Buys-The-Months: "I have no work for you. Salts-The-Catch is a fish-trader who sells me my gang's food. She asked at the pier for anyone off my ship who saw the camp burn. A guest of hers, Nesh-Deeka, pays for work. Go to Nesh-Deeka. Keep to the shore going east, a fair way. You pass the old lighthouse, and then you are in Lilmoth. Keep on until you reach the second of the big ships, the one at anchor off Lilmoth's own dock. Salts-The-Catch's house is south of that ship, beside a wooden walkway."

content.content:
Nesh-Deeka: "Sit. Salts-The-Catch told me what Buys-The-Months said of you. I am Nesh-Deeka, and I do not lie well to a face, so I will tell you plainly. Two nights ago the gang's camp up the estuary burned. A woman with a knotted cord at her wrist killed the courier who walked with the gang. She took his satchel. The satchel was mine. Her people also cut the camp's Hist cutting, a slip of the sacred tree from which the families draw their lives. They cut it away from the eggs at its roots. The eggs died. The gang say she looked at you lying by the fire and let you live. I serve the Veiled Reed, the quiet service of the An-Xileel, the state that rules Black Marsh. Do not say that name to a stranger. Not here, not on the pier. I have work for a hand whose name is on no roll. Ask me whatever you like about it before you answer. I will tell you what I can, and where I am holding back."
Objective completed: Find Nesh-Deeka in Salts-The-Catch's house, south of the second big ship, anchored off Lilmoth's own dock.
